load_code_eval_metric: load the code_eval metric module from the Hugging Face evaluate library
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the code_eval metric
run_code_eval: run the code_eval metric to evaluate code generation outputs against test cases
compute_code_eval_score: compute code evaluation scores by passing solutions and test cases to the loaded module
build_gradio_interface: build a Gradio-based interactive interface for testing the code_eval metric
